gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Total Governmental Funds Total revenues 6,250,466 = General Fund 5,373,538 + Debt Service Fund 118,169 + Special Projects Fund 364,782 + Other Governmental Funds 393,977. detail[] 5,832,823 = General Fund p7 5,373,538 + Special Projects budget-basis schedule p6 65,308 + Other Governmental Funds combining p13 393,977. (1) Missing fund column: the Debt Service Fund column (p4) has no schedule and is not in detail[]: Property taxes 114,715 + Special assessments 470 + Interest 2,984 = 118,169 (added). (2) Different basis: the Special Projects Fund budget-basis schedule p6 prints Total revenues 65,308 (Intergovernmental 13,162, Interest 21,946, Miscellaneous 30,200) while the GAAP statement p4 Special Projects column prints 364,782 (Intergovernmental 313,615, Interest 21,946, Miscellaneous 29,221): 364,782 - 65,308 = 299,474. Check: 5,832,823 + 118,169 + 299,474 = 6,250,466. After the fix the schedule stays 299,474 short, the budget-basis vs GAAP difference of the Special Projects Fund.

The General Fund is recorded gross from the p4 General Fund column (as in FY2022/FY2023): add Transfers In 100,000 here and Transfers Out (120,590) under transfers_out, removing the net line.
